mit-build-pipelines.subject: mit-lincoln-laboratory
mit-build-pipelines.application_text: Improved developer velocity by optimizing Android and web build pipelines using Gradle, Java, Kotlin, Vite, and ESBuild while reducing local environment configuration drift.
mit-build-pipelines.public_text: Improved developer velocity by optimizing Android and web build pipelines using Gradle, Java, Kotlin, Vite, and ESBuild while reducing local environment configuration drift.

mit-usaid-mobile.subject: mit-lincoln-laboratory
mit-usaid-mobile.application_text: Engineered a low-connectivity mobile tracking system for USAID commodity monitoring, field-testing pilot shipments to Africa and enabling end-to-end supply-chain visibility in constrained network environments.
mit-usaid-mobile.public_text: Delivered a low-connectivity mobile tracking system for humanitarian commodity monitoring, supporting end-to-end supply-chain visibility in constrained network environments.

mit-deconfliction-funding.subject: mit-lincoln-laboratory
mit-deconfliction-funding.application_text: Contributed to approximately $1M in follow-on sponsor funding by designing and delivering a humanitarian deconfliction notification platform for no-strike-zone visualization and secure, auditable analyst reporting.
mit-deconfliction-funding.public_text: Contributed to approximately $1M in follow-on sponsor funding by designing and delivering a humanitarian deconfliction platform for secure, auditable analyst reporting.

mit-investigative-analysis.subject: mit-lincoln-laboratory
mit-investigative-analysis.application_text: Built a counter-human-trafficking investigation tool for law enforcement, enabling analysts to triage large volumes of digital evidence and reduce time to actionable leads.
mit-investigative-analysis.public_text: Built an investigative analysis tool that helped analysts triage large volumes of digital evidence and reduce time to actionable leads.

mit-geospatial-systems.subject: mit-lincoln-laboratory
mit-geospatial-systems.application_text: Shipped externally accessible geospatial decision-support applications integrating shared data hubs, interactive maps, and domain-specific analytical datasets for government and research sponsors.
mit-geospatial-systems.public_text: Shipped geospatial decision-support applications integrating shared data hubs, interactive maps, and domain-specific analytical datasets for government and research sponsors.

mit-disaster-response.subject: mit-lincoln-laboratory
mit-disaster-response.application_text: Delivered field-ready mobile capabilities for NATO disaster-response exercises, including real-time hazard visualization, area-of-interest management, and location reporting across multinational operations.
mit-disaster-response.public_text: Delivered field-ready mobile capabilities for multinational disaster-response exercises, including hazard visualization, area-of-interest management, and location reporting.

incompris-local-first.subject: incompris
incompris-local-first.application_text: Architected and developed Ego Hygiene, a local-first Flutter platform using Dart, Riverpod 3, Drift, Freezed, offline-first repository abstractions, and provider-independent AI interfaces.
incompris-local-first.public_text: Architected and developed Ego Hygiene, a local-first Flutter platform using Dart, Riverpod 3, Drift, Freezed, offline-first repository abstractions, and provider-independent AI interfaces.

incompris-publishing.subject: incompris

incompris-publishing.public_text: Engineered deterministic publishing infrastructure that transforms structured Markdown specifications and JSON/YAML schemas into compiled, validated LaTeX documents for print and digital workflows.

incompris-quality-gates.subject: incompris

incompris-quality-gates.public_text: Implemented repository quality gates and TeX metadata validation using Python, Taskfile, and GitHub Actions to support reproducible document builds.

incompris-bounded-agents.subject: incompris
incompris-bounded-agents.application_text: Designed AI-assisted workflow architectures that treat language-model agents as bounded components with explicit schemas, context assembly, tool registries, synchronization checkpoints, and verification loops.
incompris-bounded-agents.public_text: Designed AI-assisted workflow architectures that treat language-model agents as bounded components with explicit schemas, context assembly, tool registries, synchronization checkpoints, and verification loops.

incompris-multimodal.subject: incompris

incompris-multimodal.public_text: Created multimodal media-generation pipelines integrating language models, image and video generation, metadata processing, and publication tooling into automated creative and technical workflows.
